steps.title: ENTER THE CORE
steps.text: Camera tour. Click SKIP, press Enter / Space, or gamepad A to start.

steps.title: TRAINING 1 / MOVE
steps.text:
Move toward the gold marker.
{MOVE} / arrows, left stick, or touch joystick.

steps.title: TRAINING 2 / MAKE YOUR LUCK
steps.text:
Your VALUE is 1. Collect +6 to make 7.
1 + 6 = 7. The gold rule is your target.

steps.title: LUCKY! YOU MADE 7
steps.text:
Matching the rule unleashes a powerful attack.
Your VALUE resets to 1. HP is a separate bar.

steps.title: TRAINING 3 / FIRE
steps.text:
Fire three shots: {FIRE}, hold mouse click, RT/RB, or FIRE.
Shoot +/- orbs to flip their sign in the real battle.

steps.title: TRAINING 4 / DASH
steps.text:
Move and dash: {DASH}, gamepad A, or DASH.
Dash also flips your VALUE: +1 becomes -1.

steps.title: TRAINING 5 / DODGE
steps.text:
Keep moving through the gaps for 12 seconds.
Practice hits cannot take your HP. The live round is next.
